body:
Maia: Kicking off a short microstory for our UX customer — want to keep it snappy (1x 200-300 word case + 30s social clip). Recording window this week?
Josh: I can do recording Thu 10–11am PT or Fri 2–3pm PT. Will capture a quick 3 Qs: problem, outcome (metrics), and one soundbite.
Eva: Thu 10 works for the customer. they'll need a short prep doc. share the Qs?
Josh: Draft Qs pasted below — feel free to redline.
```
1) What was the problem you were solving?
2) How did Redwood Inference change the outcome (metrics / speed / cost)?
3) Can you share one short quote we can use in a tweet + site callout?
```
Sudha: Quick legal flag — need an explicit usage release for the quote + permission to use company logo. can you add a one-liner in the prep doc and collect a signed email?
Maia: Good call. I'll add a release checkbox in the prep doc and export a PDF release we can attach. action: Maia to add release text + send to customer after recording.
Daniel: Sales ask — please add SFDC tagging so inbound leads from the publish get routed to my team. Case tag: `Case: UX-MICRO-2026`. Also we want a 15-min demo invite in the publish CTA.
Josh: Uploaded draft transcript + rough quote to Drive: https://drive.redwood/ux-microstory/draft.txt — the quote currently: "Redwood cut inference latency by 3x and reduced token cost by ~40%, which made our feature viable."
Eva: Customer suggested tightening the second clause to "reduced per-token costs by ~40% on our production workload" — ok to use?
Sudha: That's fine but remove the exact percentage if they won't sign off — legal prefers qualitative + approval. If they confirm in reply email, we can keep numbers. Otherwise: "significantly reduced per-token cost."
Josh: Updated copy in drive with both variants, flagged lines for customer to approve. Pinged them for a one-line approval reply.
Maia: Timeline check — recording Thu, editing + transcript Thu afternoon, legal signoff Fri morning, publish next Tue. Is that realistic?
Josh: Yes. I'll cut the 30s social clip Fri AM and drop assets in the release folder.
Daniel: Once published please add a lead routing rule: if asset clicked from EU region, route to EU SDR queue, else NA queue. I'll share the SFDC rule snippet.
Maia: Noted. @Sudha once you have a signed email can you drop it in /marketing/legal/releases/UX-microstory.pdf and confirm AAA?
Sudha: Will do. Please cc me on the approval email so I have the timestamp.
Lexi-bot: Calendar event created: UX Microstory recording — Thu 10:00–10:30 PT (Maia, Josh, Eva, Customer Rep). Meeting link included.
Josh: Quick check — do we want a short case landing page or just a blog + tweet?
Maia: Both, but landing page can be the simple one-paragraph template + 1 quote and screenshot. I'll make a lightweight page (no long form).
Eva: I can provide a screenshot and metrics snippet after recording.
Maia: OK next steps recap: 1) Josh records Thu 10 (capture audio + short screen), 2) Maia adds release text + sends approval email post-recording, 3) Customer replies with one-line approval (copy or approve numbers), 4) Sudha stores signed approval and clears copy, 5) Josh produces 30s clip + assets, 6) Daniel gets SFDC tagging rules added before publish, 7) Publish Tue and route leads.
Josh: I'll post the final asset links in this thread when ready.
Maia: Thanks everyone — small and fast. :rocket:
